description: Digest-pins the Docker base images and the GitHub Actions. The Debian base image updates itself (digest, minor and patch) once the build check passes; a new Debian release (major), every action update and every new STK release wait for a manual merge.

customManagers.description: STK_VERSION in the Dockerfile follows the STK releases. The checksum next to it is not touched: see the README, .github/scripts/update-stk-sha.sh

packageRules.description: Debian base image: security fixes arrive as digest updates of trixie-slim
A new Debian release (trixie to forky) changes the library package names of the runtime stage

This repository's own image, which compose.example.yaml names with a tag on purpose (latest): pinning it by digest would mix a non-automerge update into the Debian pin PR and open a new PR after every publish, since every publish has a new digest

A new STK release is a decision, never an automerge: clients and servers of different major versions do not play together, so the players have to update first. Only plain releases (1.5, 1.6), no release candidates. The PR fails the build on the stale STK_SHA256 until update-stk-sha.sh has been run on its branch.
